status: proposal; Director review required before prepare-start

inheritance.dedicated_tmux_server: Global environment copied from the Director-invoked prepare-start process at server start, minus the removed_variables below; prepare-start verifies their absence with show-environment -g before any driver launch.
inheritance.controller_pane: Dedicated server environment plus the two explicit selections below; TMUX/TMUX_PANE are set by the dedicated server.
inheritance.runner_pane: Dedicated server environment plus the selections production split_window and the capture adapter pass with -e.
inheritance.native_child: Runner process environment plus the SpawnSpec CAFLEET_DATABASE_URL override; credentials and native/project/managed/provider configuration are inherited unchanged.

explicit_selections.name: CAFLEET_NATIVE_CAPTURE_CONFIG
explicit_selections.note: The native child may inherit this runner-pane variable; it names a private case file and carries no credential.

inherited_configuration_note: Paths are references only; existence, contents and effective policy are not recorded. Project settings above the case cwd may apply and can change the observed outcome, which is recorded as observed.

removed_variables.scope: Environment of every tmux client the script runs, so the client that starts the dedicated server never seeds them, and of the native --version evidence command.
removed_variables.reason: A Claude Code Director's shell exports session markers, a Director-session messaging credential and herdr placement variables. Production member creation launches from the multiplexer server rather than the Director shell, so the case native launch omits them.
removed_variables.decision: Director99 decisions (a) and F7, design-doc Step 6 marker, fleet 25.
removed_variables.actual_names_record: prepare-start publishes the names it removed, never values, as removed-environment.json in the case cwd and requires show-environment -g to contain none of them before any driver launch.
removed_variables.guard_behavior: Whether the native CLI refuses launch with these present remains unverified; removal is applied independently of that.
